description: This file defines a Java class 'SampleGattAttributes' that maintains a static collection of GATT attribute UUIDs mapped to their human-readable names, providing a lookup method to retrieve attribute names based on UUIDs in the context of Bluetooth LE GATT profiles.

classes.name: SampleGattAttributes
classes.description: A utility class providing a mapping from GATT attribute UUIDs to attribute names for Bluetooth LE services and characteristics.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of a GATT attribute given its UUID, or a default name if not found.
